_comment: Saved sample of FERC eLibrary AdvancedSearch `searchHits`, trimmed to the fields the ingestion script reads. Grouped by the query that returns them. Descriptions, dockets, dates and accession-number formats follow real eLibrary records; the denied, withdrawn and LNG cases use made-up applicants so each outcome path is covered.
